About us

Serving Myanmar’s healthcare sector since 2013

Since 2013, Maung Maung Myint Co., Ltd has proudly served Myanmar's healthcare sector as a licensed distributor of high-quality pharmaceutical products.

Our story

Safe, effective and trusted pharmaceutical products

Maung Maung Myint Co., Ltd (MMMPharma) was established to serve Myanmar's growing need for safe, effective and trusted pharmaceutical products.

Maung Maung Myint Co., Ltd is a trusted pharmaceutical distributor dedicated to improving healthcare access across Myanmar. We specialise in high-quality, GMP-certified and FDA-approved products.

We supply our products to licensed hospitals, clinics and pharmacies, and we do not sell directly to individuals.

2013Established
in Yangon

Our mission

To improve the health and well-being of Myanmar's people through accessible, high-quality and affordable medicines.

Our vision

To become Myanmar's leading and most trusted pharmaceutical supplier.

Our core values

Four values guide how we source, store and supply medicines

  • Quality

    We uphold the highest standards in pharmaceutical manufacturing to ensure safety and effectiveness.

  • Integrity

    We operate with transparency, ethics and accountability in all aspects of our business.

  • Reliability

    We ensure dependable supply through robust quality control and efficient operations.

  • Responsibility

    We are committed to ethical practices and contributing positively to our communities.

What we stand for

How we work

  • Serving since 2013

    A licensed pharmaceutical distributor serving Myanmar’s healthcare sector since 2013.

  • GMP-certified sourcing

    We source our products from GMP-certified manufacturers to ensure the highest quality standards.

  • FDA-approved products

    Our key products meet international and local FDA standards for trusted quality and safety.

  • Distribution network

    Our extensive distribution network ensures timely deliveries across Myanmar.

  • Regulatory compliance

    We adhere strictly to Myanmar’s pharmaceutical regulations for full legal and ethical compliance.

  • Customer care

    We are committed to exceptional service, responsiveness and long-term customer care.

Who we serve
